segments.text: Nadie le prometió un camino fácil. Aun así, tomó las riendas y avanzó sin dudar.
visualConcepts: knight in weathered steel plate armor, great helm and dark cloak, with his black warhorse
armored knight on horseback on a stony road among ruined walls
segments.visibleAction: the knight urges the black warhorse from a standstill into a steady walk forward along the stony road
segments.actionStart: the knight sits in the saddle of the still black warhorse on the stony road, reins in his hands, one front hoof slightly lifted
segments.actionEnd: horse and knight walk forward, fully in frame, hooves scattering dust and small stones

segments.text: El viento golpeaba de frente y la cuesta no acababa, pero siguió, paso a paso.
visualConcepts: the same knight on foot leading his black warhorse by the reins up a steep rocky slope
armored knight climbing a windswept mountain slope with his horse
segments.visibleAction: the knight climbs one step up the rocky slope, pulling the horse by the reins against the wind
segments.actionStart: the knight stands on the slope leaning into the wind, reins in his hand, the horse just below him
segments.actionEnd: the knight is one step higher, the horse following him up, his cloak blown by the wind, both fully in frame

segments.text: Cuando el cansancio lo derribó, clavó la espada en la tierra y volvió a levantarse.
visualConcepts: the same knight kneeling on one knee on the dirt road, hands on his planted sword, his horse behind
exhausted armored knight leaning on his sword on a muddy road
segments.visibleAction: the knight pushes himself up from one knee, leaning on his sword, and stands upright
segments.actionStart: the knight kneels on one knee on the dirt road, both hands on the hilt of his sword planted in the ground, head bowed
segments.actionEnd: the knight stands upright, sword held at his side, facing forward, the horse still behind him

segments.text: Mantener el rumbo no es no caer nunca. Es levantarse cada vez y seguir adelante.
visualConcepts: the same knight riding the black warhorse along a high ridge toward a distant dark castle
lone armored rider on a ridge at dusk facing a distant castle
segments.visibleAction: the knight rides the black warhorse forward along the ridge toward the distant castle
segments.actionStart: the knight sits still on the black warhorse at the edge of the ridge, facing the distant castle on the horizon
segments.actionEnd: horse and rider walk forward along the ridge toward the castle, still fully in frame, hooves raising a little dust
